rationale: The answer is concrete and supported by the preserved bundle. `command.go:1794-1803` shows `Command.Flag(name)` first checks `c.Flags().Lookup(name)` and then calls `c.persistentFlag(name)`; `command.go:1805-1816` shows that lookup includes accumulated parent persistent flags. The qualification that parent flags must be persistent is also supported by `command.go:1655-1666`, which says local non-persistent flags do not persist to subcommands. This correctly answers how a subcommand can access a global flag.
